messages.english: Enter nursery tray dimensions in centimetres or inches.
messages.translation: Faka izilinganiso zamathileyi ezithombo ngamasentimitha noma ngamayintshi.

messages.english: Enter usable nursery surface in square metres or square feet.
messages.translation: Faka indawo yokukhulisa izithombo esebenzisekayo ngamamitha-skwele noma ngamafithi-skwele.

messages.english: Keep nursery entries until their save is confirmed.
messages.translation: Shiya imininingwane yezithombo oyifakile isekhona kuze kuqinisekiswe ukulondolozwa kwayo.

messages.english: Choose your units, enter tray sizes and usable growing surface, then save. Unknown equipment values stay blank; zero stock stays zero.
messages.translation: Khetha amayunithi akho, faka osayizi bamathileyi nendawo yokukhulisa esebenzisekayo, bese uyalondoloza. Amanani ezinto zokusebenza angaziwa ahlala engenalutho; isitoko sezinto esiyiqanda sihlala siyiqanda.
